messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert P12345 fired — GPU_SOFT_OOM_HIGH on pool infer-east2-a (severity: P1) at 2026-03-17T02:10:32Z
oncall_alice: Acked P12345. I'm taking the page and starting triage.
sre_bob: I'm online. Any NVML / kernel logs yet?
oncall_alice: Quick paste from gpu-12 logs:
```
2026-03-17T02:10:28Z nvml: failed to allocate 536870912 bytes
2026-03-17T02:10:29Z cuda: out of memory during kernel launch
2026-03-17T02:10:30Z kernel: GPU memory fragmentation detected, reclaim failed
```
oncall_alice: Symptoms: intermittent 503s for generation requests, ~3% error rate spike, increased latency for long-decoding calls.
ml_ops_carol: Correlating — we see a sudden spike in kv-prefetch and very long decode latencies for model redwood-2.1-8k starting ~02:08 UTC. Looks like a prefetch surge.
support_dave: Customer "Orchid" alerted support: ~10% of their requests hit errors starting ~02:09; they surfaced a few stack traces.
oncall_alice: Immediate mitigations proposed: 1) scale out GPU pool +4 nodes 2) throttle kv-prefetch on router to limit concurrent prefetches 3) enable fallback to quantized variant for new requests 4) drain the most-fragmented node if it flaps.
sre_bob: K8s scale first. Running: `kubectl -n inference scale deployment/gpu-pool --replicas=20` — applying now.
oncall_alice: Applying router throttle: setting PREFETCH_LIMIT=4 via config rollout. Rolling to edge routers only.
ml_ops_carol: Triggering hot fallback config: add route rule to map redwood-2.1-8k -> redwood-2.1-8k-quantized for requests with >200 token prefix. Deploying policy.
incident-bot: PagerDuty P12345 acknowledged by oncall_alice at 2026-03-17T02:12:05Z
sre_bob: Autoscaler accepted new replica count, nodes provisioning; will take ~90s to join.
support_dave: Orchid on support thread says errors dropped to ~2% after initial throttle applied.
oncall_alice: Observability: CPU on workers stable, GPU mem usage shows heavy transient spikes and high fragmentation. Evictions observed on gpu-12 twice.
sre_bob: Drained gpu-12 with `kubectl cordon node/gpu-12` + `kubectl drain --ignore-daemonsets node/gpu-12` to avoid repeated evictions.
oncall_alice: Drained node completed. Traffic rebalanced.
ml_ops_carol: Adding a temporary rate-limit rule to the prefetch queue to avoid bouncing back. Rule ID: temp-prefetch-2898.
support_dave: Customer Orchid confirms errors down to 0.7% and latency back to normal for most requests. Thanks.
oncall_alice: Creating follow-up ticket: INC-2026-2898 "GPU soft-oom with kv-prefetch surge" and assigning to eng-runtime for root cause + long-term guardrails.
sre_bob: Note: dmesg shows fragmentation warnings. I'll capture heap/profile dumps and attach to ticket.
oncall_alice: Handoff plan: I'll keep a 20m watch, then handoff to oncall_maria for the overnight window. Runbook referenced: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/gpu-soft-oom
oncall_maria: Ack. I'll take over at 03:30 UTC for 1hr watch; please DM if anything regresses.
incident-bot: PagerDuty P12345 status updated to mitigated at 2026-03-17T03:12:00Z
oncall_alice: Closing page here — mitigations held, customers stable. Follow-up actions in INC-2026-2898: throttles, autoscaler tuning, fragmentation analysis, and model prefetch limits.
sre_bob: Logged kernel/nvml traces to the ticket and attached `nvml-snapshot-2898765432.tar.gz`.
ml_ops_carol: Adding an automated short-term policy to limit long-decode concurrency per worker to 2 as a safety valve.
support_dave: Notified Orchid success; they'll reopen if anything pops back.
oncall_maria: Taking watch. Thanks team.
